trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.text: Reach 100% completion; the checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but progress made during the story already counts.
Requirements are lenient — closer to 60% true completion: 70 of 80 challenges, scan 200 of 277 vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals, 100 optional missions, 300 stunts.
Nothing toward 100% is missable; everything is doable after the story in free-roam.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion; the checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion [3][4]. Requirements are lenient — closer to 60% true completion: 70 of 80 challenges, scan 200 of 277 vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals, 100 optional missions, 300 stunts [3]. trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

steps.text: Complete any 250 of 397 stunts; 100% completion needs 300.
Four kinds: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights, 25 Base Jumps — mix them; Under the Bridges are quickest.
Track by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of 397 stunts; 100% needs 300 [3]. Four kinds: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights, 25 Base Jumps — Under the Bridges are quickest [3]. Track under Progress > Activities > Stunts [3].

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.

steps.text: Try each of the 9 activity types once; check Progress > Activities.
Types: Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball, playing a Video Game, winning a race, performing a stunt.
You will do most of them naturally while working on other trophies.

trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once; check Progress > Activities [3]. Types include Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball, a Video Game, a race win and a stunt [3]. Most come naturally [3].

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.

steps.text: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across 12 ranges.
Shooting-range gold medals are not too difficult, per PowerPyx.

trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across 12 ranges [3]. The gold medals are not too difficult, per PowerPyx [3].

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.

steps.text: Finish Andy's 5 quests (Lucia only, from Chapter 3): Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass.
The questline auto-marks in Chapter 3 after a call from Andy; all quests are still available after the story.

trophies.guide: Finish Andy's 5 quests (Lucia only, from Chapter 3): Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass [3]. The questline auto-marks in Chapter 3; all quests remain available after the story [3].

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.

steps.text: Finish Kenton's questline: clear 7 shipwrecks (treasure diving) and return the treasures to him.
Marked automatically in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams; Kenton is temporarily unavailable in Chapter 2 but returns — not missable.

trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline: clear 7 shipwrecks (treasure diving) and return the treasures to him [3]. Marked automatically in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams; Kenton returns after a Chapter 2 absence — not missable [3].

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.

steps.text: Finish Billy's 5 quests (from Chapter 2, Coffee Break; Thrillbilly Mudclub, Kelly County): Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, Hometown Heroes.

trophies.guide: Finish Billy's 5 quests (from Chapter 2, Coffee Break; Thrillbilly Mudclub, Kelly County): Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, Hometown Heroes [3].

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.

steps.text: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers; only certain questlines count (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie do NOT count).
Confirmed counters: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing), Pilot Pete (deliveries) — more strangers yet to be discovered.
Start Yago's chain promptly in Chapter 3: one checklist warns Race Against Yago may expire [6]. PowerPyx says time-sensitive quests are not trophy-relevant [3]. Our call: do Yago early anyway.

trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers; only certain questlines count (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie do NOT count) [3]. Start Yago's chain promptly in Chapter 3 — one checklist warns Race Against Yago may expire [6] — though PowerPyx says time-sensitive quests are not trophy-relevant [3]; our call is to do Yago early anyway.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.

steps.text: Finish Randy's Wish List: deliver 16 sports cars he wants (starts after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS).
Track under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; deliver in good condition for more pay.

trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List: deliver 16 sports cars he wants (starts after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS) [3]. Track under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List [3].

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

steps.text: Finish Tyrone's questline (Jason only, from Chapter 3 Here, Kitty Kitty): destroy the Synthetic Labs, then do Spin On This.

trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline (Jason only, from Chapter 3 Here, Kitty Kitty): destroy the Synthetic Labs, then do Spin On This [3].

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

steps.text: Meditate at every spot: 18 Meditation Spots across 10 locations; meditating with both Lucia and Jason at one spot counts +2.

MISSABLE: the first meditation is Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony, choose Accept. Gone after Chapter 1.

Whether the Chapter 1 meditation is required is UNCONFIRMED: it adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a Meditation Spot. PowerPyx's author did it and earned the trophy [3][4]. Our call: do it anyway, and make a manual save first.
Track under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations; 100% completion needs only 15 of 18.

trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot: 18 Meditation Spots across 10 locations; meditating with both Lucia and Jason at one spot counts +2 [3][4]. MISSABLE: the first meditation is Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony, choose Accept; gone after Chapter 1 [3][4][6]. Whether it is required is UNCONFIRMED [3][4] — our call: do it anyway, and make a manual save first. 100% needs only 15 of 18 [3].

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.

steps.text: Hunt a unique animal for Bret (Jason only; questline starts after Chapter 2 Coffee Break via a text from Bret Vogel, Lummox County).
Bret gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him.
Which exact animal unlocks the trophy is still unconfirmed; complete all 15 Target Decks (needed for 100% anyway).

trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret (Jason only; questline starts after Chapter 2 Coffee Break via a text from Bret Vogel, Lummox County) [3]. Bret gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle [3]. Which exact animal unlocks the trophy is still unconfirmed — complete all 15 Target Decks (needed for 100% anyway) [3].

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.

steps.text: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
Available after Chapter 2 Coffee Break (free-roam together); call your partner with Right + Triangle, cause carnage to 4 stars, then escape — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia is the easy route.
Comes automatically during the Chapter 4 bank-vault robberies (always 4 stars).

trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat [1][3]. Available after Chapter 2 Coffee Break; call your partner with Right + Triangle, reach 4 stars, then escape — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia is the easy route [3]. It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 bank-vault robberies [3].

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

steps.text: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
Available after Chapter 2 Coffee Break; keep the flashing wanted level (not the red heat level); equip armor, sticky bombs, Zombix/Adrenaline.
Best spot: the 3 Jewelry Stores in north Vice City (after Chapter 3 Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs); the pop is delayed ~30 seconds after leaving the 3rd shop.

trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level [1][3]. Available after Chapter 2 Coffee Break; keep the flashing wanted level (not the red heat level); equip armor, sticky bombs, Zombix/Adrenaline [3]. Best spot: the 3 Jewelry Stores in north Vice City (after Chapter 3 Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs); the pop is delayed ~30 seconds after leaving the 3rd shop [3].

trophies.name: Whip It Good

steps.text: Discover 100 vehicles: scan them with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1) — scanning is enough, no need to drive them.
557 vehicles at launch; 100% needs 200 of 277 base models scanned.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles: scan them with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1) — scanning is enough, no need to drive them [3]. 557 vehicles at launch; 100% needs 200 of 277 base models scanned [3].

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

steps.text: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming; drains the purple focus bar).
Buff focus first (food, Adrenaline), line up 5 enemies (e.g. at Gang Operations), use an assault rifle like the Duke 556; it does not work on soldiers, police or civilians.
Focus reaches level 4 naturally while working on other trophies.

trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming; drains the purple focus bar) [3]. Buff focus first (food, Adrenaline), line up 5 enemies (e.g. at Gang Operations), use an assault rifle like the Duke 556; it does not work on soldiers, police or civilians [3]. trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.

steps.text: Steal a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal at VCIA (not one on the airfield).
Easiest: terminal E3/E4 — enter via the stairs by the boarding bridge, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip, take off and fly 1 km away.

trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal at VCIA (not one on the airfield) [3]. Easiest: terminal E3/E4 — enter via the stairs by the boarding bridge, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip, take off and fly 1 km away [3].

trophies.name: Challenging Tank

steps.text: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station (south-west island, Mariana County); tanks stand in the south of the base.
Enter a tank and shoot enemies until it pops.

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station (south-west island, Mariana County); tanks stand in the south of the base [3]. Enter a tank and shoot enemies until it pops [3].

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

steps.text: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3 Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun.
Enter through the backdoor with the Snap Gun (silent lockpick), find the safe code note, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm.
Good spot: Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds, Vice City.

trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3 Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun [3]. Enter through the backdoor with the Snap Gun (silent lockpick), find the safe code note, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm [3]. Good spot: Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds, Vice City [3].

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

steps.text: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape; 8 large bank jobs exist, 100% needs all 8.
Unlocks in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe): tail a security van to a bank, enter while the vault is open, bring your partner to carry a bag.
Afterward, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (purple icons); vaults instantly give 4 stars — escape by fast motorcycle.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape; 8 large bank jobs exist, 100% needs all 8 [3]. Unlocks in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe): tail a security van to a bank, enter while the vault is open, bring your partner to carry a bag [3]. Afterward, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (purple icons); vaults instantly give 4 stars — escape by fast motorcycle [3].

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.

steps.text: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Unlocks in the same Chapter 4 mission as Maximum Withdrawal — robbing a bank vault counts as an armored truck.
Earlier method: block an armored truck near a bank, sticky-bomb its back door, escape the red heat radius.

trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Unlocks in the same Chapter 4 mission as Maximum Withdrawal — robbing a bank vault counts as an armored truck [3]. Earlier method: block an armored truck near a bank, sticky-bomb its back door, escape the red heat radius [3].

trophies.name: The Goodtime State

steps.text: Explore all of Leonida: fully unfog the whole map — easiest by plane, flying over fogged areas.
PSN tracks 52 areas.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: fully unfog the whole map — easiest by plane, flying over fogged areas [3]. PSN tracks 52 areas [2].

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.

steps.text: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang: 9 gangs, 39 operations; 1 per gang is enough for the trophy, all 39 for 100%.
Track under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang: 9 gangs, 39 operations; 1 per gang is enough for the trophy, all 39 for 100% [3]. Track under Progress > Gangs [3].

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

steps.text: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini and drink it standing next to the bar.

trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini and drink it standing next to the bar [3][5].

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.

steps.text: Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the window.
Only after obtaining the Key Cloner in Chapter 3 (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS); only the blue Banshee counts.

trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the window [3][5]. Only after obtaining the Key Cloner in Chapter 3 (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS); only the blue Banshee counts [3].

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.

steps.text: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, Port Gellhorn: the Luxury watch (south-east office), the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun (north-east table), and the safe (north-east hallway, code 0300 or sticky bombs).
Unlocks during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling; the trophy pops after escaping the police. Items do not all need to be stolen in one visit.

trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, Port Gellhorn: the Luxury watch (south-east office), the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun (north-east table), and the safe (north-east hallway, code 0300 or sticky bombs) [3]. Unlocks during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling; the trophy pops after escaping the police. Items do not all need to be stolen in one visit [3][5].

trophies.name: Personal Best

steps.text: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time.
Available after Chapter 2 Coffee Break (character switching); work out at fitness clubs together (call your partner with Right + Triangle — the other trains automatically).
Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon).

trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time [3][5]. trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

steps.text: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile; view progress by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.
Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On); every robbery and enemy encounter counts — it comes passively.

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile; view progress by clicking the trophy in the trophy list [3][5]. trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

steps.text: Return to the Payday Loans store Lucia robbed in the Prologue and rob it again as Lucia, alone, then escape on foot (not in a vehicle).
Earliest: after the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer.
GTAScoop lists this method as 'not known yet' [5]; PowerPyx gives the full method above [3]. Our call: follow PowerPyx — it is specific and testable.

trophies.guide: Return to the Payday Loans store Lucia robbed in the Prologue and rob it again as Lucia, alone, then escape on foot (not in a vehicle) [3]. trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

steps.text: Complete the UFO easter egg: at night after 2AM, on the road north-west of Starlet Motel, Kelly County, alone.
If a blinking car is at the roadside, follow the path into the woods to the UFO (bright blue light), approach it — it drops an abducted woman; talk to her and help her back to her car.
The spawn is slightly random, not guaranteed; drive away and come back if the car is not there.

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg: at night after 2AM, on the road north-west of Starlet Motel, Kelly County, alone [3][5]. The spawn is slightly random, not guaranteed; drive away and come back if the car is not there [3].

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.

steps.text: Drive any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds — best in crowded areas like Vice City or Ocean Beach.
GTAScoop lists this as 'not known yet' [5]; PowerPyx gives the method above [3]. Our call: follow PowerPyx.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops; fastest on guns, car mods and tattoos [3].

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

steps.text: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app; the app installs after Chapter 2 Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses).
You need enough garage spots first (see Little Boxes); drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register.
Cheap low-end cars and bikes keep the cost down; cars with Standard Trackers can be registered at Pay 'n' Sprays from Chapter 3.
